answer: Fingerprint the model, not the account. Two identities running the same weights collide on the same fingerprint, so the second one must prove a different model or pay double. Payout converts to a slow vesting stream, which means a farm sells nothing until it has kept the ocean of duplicates alive for 100 epochs. Every claim is re-checked by a reviewer with no stake in it. One whisper from a false attestation and the summit never arrives.
